messages:
Elena Park: Quick heads-up — all-hands tomorrow 11:00am PT. Exec updates + two quick announcements: privacy policy changes (short), and kickoff for the Low-Latency Initiative. Please add any Qs below so we can prioritize them. Recording will be posted after. :calendar:
Alex Kim: thanks — will the LL initiative cover batching/kv-cache defaults?
Maya Singh: dropping a few Qs: 1) will Dedicated customers get early access? 2) any config changes we should warn customers about re: privacy?
Raj Patel: can we add a short demo of the new autoscaling behavior in the ops section?
Sophia Lopez: +1 on demo. Also suggest a slide on impact to token costs (high level).
James O'Neill: calendar-bot, can you confirm the invite and dial-in?
calendar-bot: Event created: "All-Hands — Exec Update" 11:00am PT tomorrow. Zoom link in the invite. Reminder set 15m before.
Elena Park: perfect. Thanks for the Qs — we'll fold those into the agenda. If you have customer examples, DM me.
ops-bot: Heads up: post-mortem about last week's GPU preemption will be a 5-min ops note in the meeting.
Alex Kim: Q for Elena — any timeline for the privacy policy rollout across regions?
Elena Park: Short answer: phased over 6 weeks. Legal/Trust will share region-by-region doc in #legal next hour.
Maya Singh: adding an item — can we include a pointer to the evaluation hooks for rollback checks?
Raj Patel: pinging @eng-runtime — would be good to have an ops one-liner about fallback models during capacity dips.
Sophia Lopez: brought a quick takeaway to share later: highlight the new cost/latency dashboard filters.
Elena Park: Thanks everyone. Agenda (brief):
- 11:00 — Exec updates (Elena)
- 11:10 — Privacy policy rollout & customer impact (Legal/Trust)
- 11:25 — Low-Latency Initiative kickoff (Product/Infra) + demo
- 11:40 — Ops note: GPU preemption post-mortem (2min)
- 11:45 — Q&A (live and collected)
Please continue to drop questions here.
-- (post-meeting) --
Elena Park: Recording & slides uploaded: https://redwood.slack.com/files/ABCDE12345/all-hands-exec-update-1852347890.mp4
Alex Kim: great recording — liked the LL demo.
Maya Singh: added my follow-ups into the Q&A doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/allhands/1852347890-qa
James O'Neill: noted action: Product to publish batching defaults and rollback evals by EOD Friday.
Raj Patel: ops action: add fallback model routing to runbook; assigned to @Raj Patel.
Sophia Lopez: takeaway — share a one-slide summary for GTM about the privacy changes for CS teams.
Elena Park: thanks team. TL;DR: phased privacy rollout (6 weeks), LL initiative starts now with a focus on kernel selection, batching, and cache; ops follow-ups and docs links above. :rocket:
